entries.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
entries.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

entries.name: liguobao/ds-harness-remote
entries.description: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 插件机制构建的远程访问方案，通过低延迟、端到端加密的 P2P 网络，支持使用 PC、移动端 和 Web 随时访问本地设备上的DSH 、CodeX、Cursor、Claude Code等工作区。 (Built on DeepSeek Harness plugins, this low-latency, end-to-end encrypted P2P solution lets PC, mobile, and web clients access local DSH, Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code workspaces.)

entries.name: datadrivenconstruction/OpenConstructionERP
entries.description: Open-source construction ERP - BOQ, PDF/CAD/BIM takeoff, AI cost matching, 293 guided cases. 120,000+ priced positions, 44 languages, 190+ modules, cost data for 40+ markets. AGPL-3.0. pip install openconstructionerp

entries.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
entries.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
